nl_question: How many available features are there in total?
What are the names of properties that are either houses or apartments with more than 1 room?
sparql_partial_uri:
PREFIX : <http://valuenet/ontop/>
SELECT distinct?col1 WHERE { { select (?t1_property_name as ?col1) where { ?t1 a :properties . ?t1 :property_name ?t1_property_name . ?t1 :property_type_code ?t1_property_type_code . FILTER(?t1_property_type_code = 'House') . }} UNION {select (?t1_property_name as ?col1) where { ?t1 a :properties . ?t1 :property_name ?t1_property_name . ?t1 :property_type_code ?t1_property_type_code . ?t1 :room_count ?t1_room_count . FILTER(?t1_property_type_code = 'Apartment' && ?t1_room_count > 1) . } } }
